services.value: Operates and maintains the wastewater collection, treatment, and discharge system for the Consolidated Sanitary District (CSD), including industrial wastewater monitoring, issuing discharge permits, and reviewing and approving plumbing plans and inspections. Its Henry Clay Laboratory performs over 100,000 analyses each year and supports water quality compliance and monitoring by collecting and analyzing environmental samples (e.g., stormwater pollutants/runoff, soils/sediments, and wastewater influent/effluent).
